new_task_1.title: Advertise the built-in Zarr backend as supporting hierarchical groups
new_task_1.description: The built-in Zarr backend entrypoint now sets `supports_groups = True`, making xarray recognize it as a group-capable backend. This is an observable behavior change for APIs and backend introspection paths that rely on the backend capability flag to determine whether an engine can open hierarchical group structures such as DataTrees or dictionaries of groups. Previously, the Zarr backend exposed group-opening methods but did not advertise that capability through the standard backend flag, so generic group-aware code could incorrectly treat `engine='zarr'` as unsupported.

synthesized_requirement.problem_statement: Ensure that xarray reports the built-in `zarr` backend as supporting hierarchical groups so group-aware APIs and backend capability checks can use it for Zarr stores containing nested groups.

expectation.grounded: The `xarray.backends.ZarrBackendEntrypoint` class must define `supports_groups = True`. Backend discovery and introspection paths that expose the `zarr` engine must therefore report it as group-capable. Generic logic that gates group-opening behavior on the `supports_groups` flag should no longer reject the built-in `zarr` engine on the basis that it lacks group support.
expectation.conceptual: Users and internal xarray dispatch should be able to treat the built-in Zarr backend as a backend that supports hierarchical group structures, rather than as a flat dataset-only backend.

constraints.grounded: This change must be limited to the backend capability contract for the built-in `zarr` engine. It must not alter `guess_can_open`, default engine selection, or non-group `open_dataset` behavior. The change must remain grounded in the existing Zarr backend entrypoint rather than introducing a separate backend or new public API.
constraints.conceptual: The fix should expose already-supported group functionality through the standard backend capability flag without changing unrelated Zarr I/O behavior.

behavior: Backend introspection for the `zarr` engine now reports that it supports hierarchical groups.
Group-aware dispatch paths that rely on the `supports_groups` flag can treat `engine='zarr'` as eligible for opening grouped Zarr hierarchies.
Non-group Zarr dataset opening behavior remains unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: When retrieving the registered `zarr` backend entrypoint from xarray, its `supports_groups` attribute should be `True`.
When code checks whether the built-in `zarr` engine supports hierarchical groups via the backend capability flag, the check should succeed.
When a group-aware xarray API dispatches based on backend `supports_groups`, specifying `engine='zarr'` should not be rejected for lacking group support.
When opening a regular non-grouped Zarr dataset with the built-in `zarr` engine, behavior should remain unchanged from before this fix.
